title.zh: Meta推出无投票权C类股并以扩大股权融资支持AI建设
title.en: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push

current_state.zh: Meta的股权融资计划已上调至975亿美元，含超额配售最高约1030亿美元，由250亿美元普通股、约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划构成；其中250亿美元普通股发行获约5倍超额认购，定价每股625美元，用于支持AI投资。
current_state.en: Meta's equity financing plan has been upsized to $97.5B, or up to about $103B including the greenshoe, comprising $25B of common stock, about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program; the $25B common stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription at $625 per share to fund AI investments.

updates.title_zh: Meta将设立新类别股票以资助AI推进
updates.title_en: Meta to create a new class of shares to fund AI push
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta将发行一个新的无投票权股票类别，自2027年起交易，用于为其AI建设、潜在收购和员工薪酬提供资金，这一信息在其2026年第三季度财报中披露。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta will issue a new non-voting class of shares, trading from 2027, to fund its AI buildout, potential acquisitions and employee compensation, as disclosed in its Q3 2026 earnings report.

updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta will issue a new non-voting class of shares, trading from 2027, to fund its AI buildout, potential acquisitions and employee compensation, as disclosed in its Q3 2026 earnings report.

updates.title_zh: Meta设立无投票权股票以资助AI建设，同时保持扎克伯格的控制权
updates.title_en: Meta Creates Non-Voting Stock to Fund AI Buildout, Keeping Zuckerberg in Control
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta董事会批准了一项无投票权的C类股票，自2027年1月19日起按一比一比例向现有股东分配，实际上相当于二比一拆股，使公司能够出售股权，为耗资数千亿美元的AI建设提供资金，同时保留马克·扎克伯格的投票控制权。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta's board approved a non-voting Class C stock — distributed one-for-one to existing holders from Jan. 19, 2027, effectively a 2-for-1 split — letting the company sell equity to fund a multi-hundred-billion-dollar AI buildout while preserving Mark Zuckerberg's voting control.

updates.current_state_en: Meta's board approved a non-voting Class C stock — distributed one-for-one to existing holders from Jan. 19, 2027, effectively a 2-for-1 split — letting the company sell equity to fund a multi-hundred-billion-dollar AI buildout while preserving Mark Zuckerberg's voting control.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta's board approved a non-voting Class C stock — distributed one-for-one to existing holders from Jan. 19, 2027, effectively a 2-for-1 split — letting the company sell equity to fund a multi-hundred-billion-dollar AI buildout while preserving Mark Zuckerberg's voting control.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta's board approved a non-voting Class C stock — distributed one-for-one to existing holders from Jan. 19, 2027, effectively a 2-for-1 split — letting the company sell equity to fund a multi-hundred-billion-dollar AI buildout while preserving Mark Zuckerberg's voting control.

updates.title_zh: Meta盘前转涨1.12%，英伟达、AMD和博通有意购买至多50亿美元Meta股票
updates.title_en: Meta盘前转涨1.12%，英伟达、AMD和博通有意购买至多50亿美元Meta股票
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta 启动约 350 亿美元的双承销股权发行——其中约 225 亿美元的 A 类普通股通过远期销售协议发行，约 125 亿美元的 A 系列强制可转换优先存托股份——据报道英伟达、AMD 和博通有意各自购买最多 50 亿美元的 Meta 股票，推动 META 盘前上涨 1.12%。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta launched a roughly $35B dual underwritten equity offering — about $22.5B of Class A common stock via forward sale agreements and about $12.5B of Series A mandatory convertible preferred depositary shares — with Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom reportedly interested in purchasing up to $5B of Meta stock each, lifting META 1.12% in premarket trading.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta 启动约 350 亿美元的双承销股权发行——其中约 225 亿美元的 A 类普通股通过远期销售协议发行，约 125 亿美元的 A 系列强制可转换优先存托股份——据报道英伟达、AMD 和博通有意各自购买最多 50 亿美元的 Meta 股票，推动 META 盘前上涨 1.12%。

updates.title_zh: 英伟达将向Meta股权发行投资30亿美元，双方扩大AI基础设施与模型合作
updates.title_en: 英伟达将向Meta股权发行投资30亿美元，双方扩大AI基础设施与模型合作
updates.what_changed_zh: 英伟达将向Meta股权发行投资30亿美元，双方并扩大AI基础设施与模型合作。
updates.what_changed_en: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in Meta's equity issuance, with the two companies expanding their AI infrastructure and model partnership.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta的约350亿美元股权发行中，英伟达将投资30亿美元，双方还将围绕OpenShell参考架构、Nvidia Sentry及Vera Rubin、Vera CPU、Spectrum-X、BlueField-4等产品扩大合作，并深化MUSE模型合作。
updates.current_state_en: Within Meta's roughly $35B equity offering, Nvidia will invest $3B; the companies are also expanding collaboration around the OpenShell reference architecture, Nvidia Sentry, Vera Rubin, Vera CPU, Spectrum-X and BlueField-4 deployments, and deepening work on MUSE models.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in a Meta equity issuance, with the two companies expanding their AI partnership across the OpenShell reference architecture, Nvidia Sentry, large-scale deployment of Vera Rubin, Vera CPU, Spectrum-X and BlueField-4, and deeper collaboration on MUSE models.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Nvidia will invest $3 billion in a Meta equity issuance, with the two companies expanding their AI partnership across the OpenShell reference architecture, Nvidia Sentry, large-scale deployment of Vera Rubin, Vera CPU, Spectrum-X and BlueField-4, and deeper collaboration on MUSE models.

updates.title_zh: Meta小幅上调股票融资计划至975亿美元，最高融资额或达1030亿美元
updates.title_en: Meta小幅上调股票融资计划至975亿美元，最高融资额或达1030亿美元
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta将股票融资计划规模从约950亿美元小幅上调至975亿美元，最高含超额配售可达约1030亿美元；普通股发行规模从225亿美元提高至250亿美元，并保留约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta raised its planned stock offering from about $95B to $97.5B, or up to roughly $103B including the greenshoe; it increased the common stock tranche from $22.5B to $25B while retaining about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and an at-the-market program of up to $60B.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta的股权融资计划已上调至975亿美元，含超额配售最高约1030亿美元，由250亿美元普通股、约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划构成，用于支持AI投资；此前英伟达30亿美元投资及双方AI合作仍在推进。
updates.current_state_en: Meta's equity financing plan has been upsized to $97.5B, or up to about $103B including the greenshoe, comprising $25B of common stock, about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program to fund AI investments; Nvidia's previously announced $3B investment and expanded AI collaboration remain in place.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta raised its planned stock offering to $97.5B — up to roughly $103B with the greenshoe — to finance artificial intelligence investments, increasing the common stock tranche to $25B alongside ~$12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta raised its planned stock offering to $97.5B — up to roughly $103B with the greenshoe — to finance artificial intelligence investments, increasing the common stock tranche to $25B alongside ~$12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program.

updates.title_zh: Meta 250亿美元股票发行获约5倍超额认购
updates.title_en: Meta 250亿美元股票发行获约5倍超额认购
updates.what_changed_zh: Meta扩大后的250亿美元普通股发行获得约5倍超额认购，定价为每股625美元，较发行前上周五收盘价折让2.7%；超过一半股份分配给长期持股投资者和现有股东，前15大投资者合计获约70%发行股份。
updates.what_changed_en: Meta's expanded $25B common stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription, priced at $625 per share, a 2.7% discount to the prior Friday close; more than half of shares were allocated to long-term and existing shareholders, with the top 15 investors receiving about 70% of the offering.
updates.current_state_zh: Meta的股权融资计划已上调至975亿美元，含超额配售最高约1030亿美元，由250亿美元普通股、约125亿美元A系列存托股及至多600亿美元按市价发行计划构成；其中250亿美元普通股发行获约5倍超额认购，定价每股625美元，用于支持AI投资。
updates.current_state_en: Meta's equity financing plan has been upsized to $97.5B, or up to about $103B including the greenshoe, comprising $25B of common stock, about $12.5B of Series A depositary shares and up to $60B through an at-the-market program; the $25B common stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription at $625 per share to fund AI investments.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Meta's expanded $25B stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription at $625 per share, part of a planned ~$98B fundraising package to fund AI spending, with over half allocated to long-term and existing shareholders.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Meta's expanded $25B stock offering drew about 5x oversubscription at $625 per share, part of a planned ~$98B fundraising package to fund AI spending, with over half allocated to long-term and existing shareholders.
